name: Barbell Rear Delt Row
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart, grasp a barbell with a wide overhand grip, and hinge forward at your hips with soft knees.
Lock your back flat and brace your core so the bar hangs straight below your chest.
Pull the bar smoothly upward toward your upper chest while flaring your elbows wide out to the sides.
Lower the bar slowly back to full arm extension while holding your torso angle steady.
tips: Keep your torso angle fixed rather than jerking upright to finish each pull.
Keep your shoulders pulled down away from your ears as you squeeze your rear delts.
